fields.name: Databases Collection
fields.responsibility: Holds every configured non-sharded database as a collection keyed by its database key, exposes each one as a read endpoint and a write endpoint, and presents on each endpoint the full set of data methods a caller invokes — returning a scalar, a list, a mapped model, a model hydrated into a supplied instance, or the output of a caller-written result handler. Choosing read or write is the caller's; this owns the addressing and the method surface, not the execution.
